sample_chunks.chunk: Dr. Supreet Khare is a board-certified physician and medical professional based in Tucson, Arizona. He is a graduate of Armed Forces Medical College (AFMC), Pune, India — one of India's most prestigious medical institutions. Dr. Khare completed his Internal Medicine Residency (ACGME-Accredited) at the University of Arizona / Banner - University Medical Center. He is currently Managing Director and CEO of Compendious Med Works Pvt. Ltd. Dr. Khare has extensive expertise in internal medicine, cardiology, neurology, and academic research. He is the first and only undergraduate medical student in India to receive the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) research scholarship consecutively for 5 years (2010-2014). He has received multiple national and international awards, presented research at the International Medical Summer School Conference in Manchester, UK, and won the Champion's Trophy awarded by Nobel Laureate Dr. Robin Warren. Dr. Khare is also an author, having written the fiction novel "Tales of Enkanto - A Paradoxical Beginning" (2012). He is a member of the American College of Physicians (ACP) and has represented his residency program on the ACP Council of Residents. His contact: supreet.khare0007@gmail.com, Phone: +1 646-203-4417. He is fluent in English and Hindi.
